response_unit: one row per participant slot and case

comprehension_correct.rule: true only when all four case criteria are correct in the first complete response without moderator teaching

terminology_preference.rule: record only on case position 3; leave blank on positions 1 and 2

terminology_burden.rule: record the more burdensome term only on case position 3; leave blank on positions 1 and 2

access-authorization.boundary: the bounded access request and applicable authorization constraints
access-authorization.source_authority: the operational approval and grant owners remain authoritative
access-authorization.unresolved_state: a pending or disputed request remains unresolved
access-authorization.projection_loss: the compact view must declare omitted approval, grant, entitlement, or constraint detail

amount-concentration-composition.boundary: the specified sample, component set, conditions, and quantity basis
amount-concentration-composition.source_authority: the governed measurement or composition source remains authoritative
amount-concentration-composition.unresolved_state: a provisional value or closure state remains unresolved
amount-concentration-composition.projection_loss: the compact view must declare omitted basis, unit, condition, uncertainty, or closure detail

choice-alternative-selection.boundary: the stated question, admitted alternatives, and hard constraints
choice-alternative-selection.source_authority: the final decision owner remains authoritative
choice-alternative-selection.unresolved_state: an unresolved or rejected recommendation is not a final selection
choice-alternative-selection.projection_loss: the compact view must declare omitted alternative, criterion, preference, constraint, or authority detail

adjudication.participant_preference_denominator: one position-3 preference per eligible participant slot
